excluded_scenarios.why: the corrected claim dates the burning of the Rock Creek bridge to the evening of Friday 26 Jun (Jacobs 1864 p.17; Early, OR27-2-R470 p.465; Compiler 29 Jun 1863 p.2); the reading jun27 of schedule row S-001 (from Wiki-GBRR, a lead source) puts it on 27 Jun, which those sources of the row contradict: the row does not hold in it (GATE-SPEC TL-8: the record states which value it excludes, and why)

evidence.state: indeterminate within date window: Intact -> Burned

not_shown.why: the product holds the burning as a date, never a time of day: in the reading jun26 the bridge is drawn half burned (a blend) through the whole of 26 Jun and burned from 27 Jun 00:00; in the opening scenario (S-001: sources vary 26 or 27) the same blend lasts through 27 Jun and the bridge is burned from 28 Jun 00:00; nothing is drawn that says the evening
no structure record, schedule row or drawn object of the product is a railroad car
the railroad is drawn as a line whose only scheduled change is the reopening on 10 Jul (S-076); the destruction of the track on 26 Jun has no state

not_shown.words: the centre span of the bridge was burnt and fell in
not_shown.why: the corrected claim carries two readings (A: Early, a small bridge burnt; B: the Compiler, the centre span burnt and fell in and the other two spans standing but badly damaged) and no default; the product draws one state for the whole bridge (burned, damage 0.3), which is reading A: reading B (one span gone, two standing) is not drawn
